notes.title: Alpha 3.5.2 Small Update
notes.content:
[h1]Important Notice[/h1]
- Please delete the optionsettings.res file in your %appdata% Epic Transport folder before playing this update.

[h1]Music[/h1]
- New song "Finality"

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed player name not appearing in message sender properly
- Fixed server host name not appearing when a player joins
- Water can no longer be placed outside of the map
- Airport strips can no longer hang off the map edge
- Fixed newly placed water tiles not updating pathfinding for boats in multiplayer

notes.title: Alpha 3.5.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]Load Problem[/h2]
- Fixed an issue with loading saves that caused heroes not to spawn in and map not properly clearing

notes.title: Ver Alpha 3.5 Heroes
notes.content:
[h1]Important Notices[/h1]

- If you have an old save in your %appdata% Epic Transport folder, it is advisable to start a fresh one for this update as there is new content.

- Currently heroes are not implemented in multiplayer they are purely singleplayer besides the exception of Doug Ocean, if you select him before hosting/joining a game you can get dual fishing outputs.

[h1]Content[/h1]

- Heroes system that includes 4 heroes each with gameplay bonuses 
- Fishing system with 7 loot types each with 4 rarities
- New Apple Orchard industry (gives bonus to walkers only)
- New Stone Mines industry (gives bonus to trains only)

[h1]Fixes / Balance[/h1]

- Planes movement behavior and giving bonus incorrectly has been fixed
- Fixed boats not spawning in for clients in multiplayer
- Speed of transport types and speed upgrades have been tweaked

[h1]Music Changes[/h1]

- New song "Universe"
- New song "Heroes"
- Music player font size reduced, next and last song buttons added

[h1]UI Changes[/h1]

- Reduced the camera's max zoom out value
- Credits updated
- The main menu is now inside of the game world rather than in a separate scene
- Maps can be generated and previewed from the main menu
- Now when typing in console hotkeys will be disabled until the message bar is no longer in focus
- The tutorial / guide is in the main world, togglable with T, no need to have it in its own world
- Tutorial / guide text has been updated

[h1]Hotkey Changes[/h1]

T - open guide
Left Mouse - selecting 
Right Mouse - camera panning
E - build
Q - remove
Mwheel Up - zoom in
Mwheel Down - zoom out
Quote Left / Tilde - console 
H - hide all menus
1 - 9 - toggle transport menus
O - options
G - stats
Shift - save
M - music
Esc - exit
C - reset camera
Delete - remove vehicle
X - deselect tile
R - set order
W,A,S,D - move hero
F - toggle fishing menu

notes.title: Ver Alpha 3.4 Multiplayer
notes.content:
- Notice: If you have an old save file or audio.res file in your %appdata% Epic Transport folder, probably best to get rid of them. 
- Multiplayer hosting/joining via IP
- Server passwords (optional)
- The console now doubles as a multiplayer chat box
- Boat pathfinding issue resolved
- There are now 3 save and load slots
- Added more icons to the menus and improved more of the in game UI
- Added settings to keep the music player or console hidden that autosaves
- Added settings to toggle full screen or Vsync that autosaves
- Now when you have a tile selected and you hover an occupied tile it won't overlap it so you can see what's beneath
- If you hover the console with your mouse it auto scrolls to the bottom (can still scroll up to see history)
- Made the console keep all of its history again rather than only showing one message
- New song added "Beyond"

notes.title: Ver Alpha 3.3
notes.content:
- Selected tile now shows up with the cursor highlight
- D hotkey added to clear selected tile
- Small UI changes
- New song added "Quantum"
- Epic bonuses and HR bonuses from research reduced
- Fixed issue with using process for vehicle movement instead of physics process
- Added a Vsync toggle in the option menu in game

notes.title: Ver Alpha 3.2
notes.content:
- Replaced audio tutorial with a full text guide in tutorial mode
- UI Updates
- New song added "Aliens"
